products.name: HotelFlow
products.tagline: All-in-one hotel operations, from front desk to housekeeping.
products.shortDescription: Streamline every aspect of hotel operations — reservations, housekeeping, billing, and guest experience — in one connected platform.
products.fullDescription: HotelFlow is being built to give independent hotels and small hotel groups a single, modern system to manage every part of their operation. From check-in to checkout, room assignments to billing, the goal is to reduce the manual overhead that currently spreads across multiple disconnected tools.
products.problem: Most independent hotels run on a patchwork of outdated systems — a legacy PMS, separate housekeeping sheets, manual billing, and disconnected guest communication. The result is wasted time, missed details, and a guest experience that suffers from the gaps in between.
whatWeAreBuilding: A unified front desk and reservation management system
Housekeeping task board with real-time room status updates
Integrated billing and folio management
Guest profile and preference tracking
Channel management for online booking sites
Reporting on occupancy, revenue, and operations

features.title: Reservation Management
features.description: A clear, visual booking calendar with drag-and-drop room assignment and multi-channel reservation sync.

features.title: Housekeeping Board
features.description: Real-time room status updates, task assignment, and inspection tracking for housekeeping teams.

features.title: Occupancy & Revenue Reporting
features.description: Daily, weekly, and monthly summaries of occupancy rates, ADR, and revenue by room type.

features.title: Folio & Billing
features.description: Guest folios, itemised charges, and checkout billing with integrated payment recording.

benefits.title: Fewer manual tasks
benefits.description: Automated status updates and task routing reduce the time staff spend on coordination.

benefits.title: Clearer guest picture
benefits.description: Guest profiles and preference notes help staff deliver a more consistent experience.

benefits.title: Operational visibility
benefits.description: Managers get a clear picture of what is happening across rooms, tasks, and revenue at any time.

audience.title: Independent hotels
audience.description: Properties of 20-200 rooms that currently rely on spreadsheets or legacy PMS software.

audience.title: Boutique hotel groups
audience.description: Small groups managing 2-5 properties that need a consistent system across locations.

audience.title: Guesthouses & B&Bs
audience.description: Owner-operated properties looking for a simple but professional front desk system.

products.name: ClinicOS
products.tagline: Clinic management built for the way medical teams actually work.
products.shortDescription: A focused clinic management system covering patient records, appointments, billing, and clinical workflow in one integrated platform.
products.fullDescription: ClinicOS is being designed for small to mid-sized clinics that need a modern, reliable system to manage their day-to-day clinical and administrative operations without the complexity of enterprise healthcare software.
products.problem: Many clinics still rely on paper records, disconnected appointment systems, and manual billing processes. The administrative burden this creates pulls clinical staff away from patient care and creates gaps that affect both the patient experience and practice efficiency.
whatWeAreBuilding: Patient registration and electronic health records (EHR) management
Appointment scheduling with SMS and email reminders
Consultation notes and clinical documentation tools
Billing, invoicing, and insurance claim tracking
Prescription management and pharmacy integration hooks
Reporting on appointment volume, billing, and clinical activity

features.title: Patient Records
features.description: Structured patient profiles, consultation history, clinical notes, and document attachments in one place.

features.title: Appointment Scheduling
features.description: A visual calendar for booking, rescheduling, and tracking appointments with automated reminders.

features.title: Clinical Documentation
features.description: Structured note templates for consultations, diagnoses, and treatment plans that save time and reduce errors.

features.title: Billing & Claims
features.description: Invoice generation, payment tracking, and insurance claim management with status visibility.

benefits.title: Less paperwork
benefits.description: Digital records and structured forms reduce the time clinical and admin staff spend on documentation.

benefits.title: Fewer missed appointments
benefits.description: Automated reminders and a clear scheduling view reduce no-shows and scheduling gaps.

benefits.title: Cleaner billing
benefits.description: Streamlined invoicing and claim tracking reduce errors and speed up payment cycles.

audience.title: General practice clinics
audience.description: GP practices and family health clinics with 2-20 practitioners.

audience.title: Specialist clinics
audience.description: Dental, physiotherapy, dermatology, and other specialist practices.

audience.title: Multi-location practices
audience.description: Clinics operating across 2-5 sites that need a consistent system.

products.name: FinanceFlow
products.tagline: Financial operations, reporting, and compliance for growing businesses.
products.shortDescription: A finance management platform covering accounting, reporting, compliance, and period close for finance teams in mid-market businesses.
products.fullDescription: FinanceFlow is being built to give finance teams in growing businesses the tools they need to manage accounts, close books efficiently, and produce reliable reports without depending on enterprise systems that are too complex and too expensive.
products.problem: Finance teams at growing businesses often outgrow basic accounting software before they are ready for enterprise ERP. They end up managing critical financial processes through spreadsheets, basic tools, and manual reconciliations — which creates risk, slows down close cycles, and limits visibility.
whatWeAreBuilding: General ledger and chart of accounts management
Accounts payable and receivable workflows
Automated period close with task tracking
Financial reporting and custom dashboards
Audit trail and compliance controls
Multi-entity support for holding companies and subsidiaries

features.title: Real-Time Analytics
features.description: Interactive dashboards, custom KPIs, and drill-down reporting across entities.

features.title: Compliance Automation
features.description: Audit trails, controlled journal entries, and automated report scheduling.

features.title: Security & Access
features.description: Role-based access controls and encryption to protect sensitive financial data.

features.title: Smart Close
features.description: Automated reconciliation, journal entry workflows, and period close task management.

benefits.title: Shorter close cycles
benefits.description: Automated workflows and real-time validation reduce the time spent on monthly and quarterly closes.

benefits.title: Clearer financial picture
benefits.description: Live dashboards give finance teams and management real-time visibility into financial position.

benefits.title: Audit-ready records
benefits.description: Continuous controls and immutable audit trails reduce the burden of internal and external audits.

audience.title: Mid-market businesses
audience.description: Companies that have outgrown basic accounting software but do not need full ERP.

audience.title: Holding companies
audience.description: Businesses managing multiple entities or subsidiaries that need consolidated reporting.

audience.title: Finance teams
audience.description: Controllers and FP&A teams responsible for close, reporting, and compliance.

products.name: MakerSuite
products.tagline: Manufacturing execution, quality, and supply-chain orchestration.
products.shortDescription: Connect the shop floor to management with real-time production tracking, quality control, and inventory visibility.
products.fullDescription: MakerSuite is being built to give manufacturing businesses a clear, connected view of what is happening on their production floor and the tools to act on it.
products.problem: Many manufacturers lack real-time visibility into what is happening on their production floor. Production status, quality issues, and inventory levels are tracked manually or in disconnected systems, making it hard to identify problems early or make informed decisions quickly.
whatWeAreBuilding: Production order and work order management
Real-time floor tracking and status dashboards
Quality inspection and non-conformance tracking
Inventory and materials management with lot tracking
Maintenance scheduling and equipment downtime logging
Production performance reporting and OEE tracking

features.title: Production Visibility
features.description: Live production dashboards, work order tracking, and progress monitoring across production lines.

features.title: Quality Management
features.description: Non-conformance tracking, inspection checklists, and corrective action workflows.

features.title: Inventory Control
features.description: Materials tracking, lot management, and stock level visibility across the production process.

features.title: Maintenance Logging
features.description: Equipment maintenance schedules and downtime recording to support uptime planning.

benefits.title: Better floor visibility
benefits.description: Real-time status dashboards give managers a clear picture of production without walking the floor.

benefits.title: Earlier quality catches
benefits.description: Structured inspection workflows help catch quality issues before they escalate.

benefits.title: Less manual tracking
benefits.description: Replacing paper-based tracking with a connected system reduces data errors and administrative time.

audience.title: Discrete manufacturers
audience.description: Businesses producing components or finished goods in batches or continuous runs.

audience.title: Process manufacturers
audience.description: Food & beverage, chemicals, and similar industries with lot-based production.

audience.title: Contract manufacturers
audience.description: Facilities producing goods for multiple clients that need per-order tracking.

products.name: RetailOptix
products.tagline: Unified commerce, inventory, and customer intelligence for retail.
products.shortDescription: Manage inventory, pricing, and customer data consistently across physical stores and online channels.
products.fullDescription: RetailOptix is being built for retailers who are managing inventory and customer data across multiple channels and need a single, reliable system to keep everything in sync.
products.problem: Retailers operating across physical stores and online channels frequently deal with inventory discrepancies, inconsistent pricing, and customer data that lives in separate systems. This fragmentation leads to stockouts, oversells, and a customer experience that varies too much depending on the channel.
whatWeAreBuilding: Unified inventory management across stores and online channels
Pricing and promotions management with rules-based logic
Customer profile and purchase history tracking
Store operations tools including task management
Sales reporting and inventory performance analytics
Integration hooks for ecommerce platforms and POS systems

features.title: Omnichannel Inventory
features.description: A single inventory view across stores and channels with allocation and availability tracking.

features.title: Pricing & Promotions
features.description: Rules-based pricing management and promotion tracking across channels.

features.title: Store Operations
features.description: Task management, store scheduling, and operational tools for store managers and teams.

features.title: Customer Intelligence
features.description: Unified customer profiles with purchase history and preference tracking.

benefits.title: Fewer inventory gaps
benefits.description: A unified inventory view reduces stockouts and discrepancies across channels.

benefits.title: Consistent customer experience
benefits.description: Shared customer data means the experience does not break down between channels.

benefits.title: Less manual reconciliation
benefits.description: Connected channels reduce the time spent reconciling data from separate systems.

audience.title: Retail chains
audience.description: Multi-store retailers that need consistent inventory and pricing management.

audience.title: Omnichannel retailers
audience.description: Businesses selling across physical stores and online channels.

audience.title: Ecommerce brands
audience.description: Online-first brands expanding into physical retail that need unified operations.
